title: Fanhua Announces Change of Name to AIX Inc. and the Results of its Extraordinary General Meeting
description: Fanhua Inc. announced the results of its extraordinary general meeting, where shareholders approved the company's name change to AIX Inc. and the re-designation of its authorized shares into Class A and Class B ordinary shares.

title: AIX Completes Strategic Share Exchange with BGM to Drive Growth in AI Insurance and Healthcare
description: AIX Inc. has successfully completed a strategic share exchange transaction with BGM Group, marking a significant milestone in its transformation within the AI-driven insurance and healthcare space. The partnership with BGM, a global leader in the pharmaceutical industry, enhances AIX's presence in the healthcare sector and creates unique opportunities to integrate AI, insurance, and healthcare solutions.
